name: The SF Cottage
tagline: Quiet 2BR cottage in Ingleside near City College — perfect for exploring SF by transit

host.name: Keith
host.bio: Superhost, 15 years hosting. SF resident 10+ years, visited 60+ countries. Happy to share local tips — just reach out!

checkin.earlyArrival: TODO: policy for early arrivals / luggage
steps: Facing the house, look left of the front windows — there's a gate to the left of the front door. That's your gate.
The gate has a white keypad on its right. Press the large button on the bottom to light it up, enter the access code, then press the checkmark.
Walk down the alley (it's lit — if the lights are out, let me know!) to the shared courtyard.
At the cottage door keypad, press the unlock button (lower left) to light it up, then enter the code.
When leaving: close the door and press the right lock button. Please also re-lock the gate the same way.

spaces.name: Living Room
spaces.details: Sectional sofa converts to bed (use the foam topper for comfort!), 50" TV on swinging arm with Netflix, dining table seats 4 (2 extra chairs available).

spaces.name: Bedroom 2 (loft)
spaces.details: Queen bed, ample closet space. Low ceiling on the sides — watch your head!

spaces.name: Kitchen
spaces.details: Full-size fridge, microwave, dishwasher, Sodastream, 12-cup coffee maker, Keurig. Well-stocked for cooking. Trash compactor.

spaces.name: Bathroom
spaces.details: Walk-in shower. Hair dryer, shampoo, conditioner, body soap provided. Shoe rack at entrance — slippers provided (shoes-off preferred).

spaces.name: Laundry
spaces.details: Free in-unit stackable washer/dryer behind the kitchen door.

spaces.name: Backyard / Courtyard
spaces.details: Shared patio, benches, firepit, fully fenced backyard, bike storage. Shared with host but rarely used.

safety: Exterior security cameras (backyard, pathway, front of house — all visible)
notIncluded: Air conditioning (portable fans provided; SF rarely needs it)

houseRules: Check-in after 3:00 PM, checkout before 11:00 AM
Pets allowed with $60 fee (assistance animals always free)
Shoes off inside preferred — slippers provided
Please re-lock the gate and cottage door when leaving
TODO: quiet hours, smoking policy, parties

transit.intro: You don't need a car! Use Clipper via Apple/Google Pay — no physical card needed. Works on all Muni and BART. Free for riders under 18. Muni = city buses/light rail; BART = regional trains.

options.name: BART Balboa Park
options.detail: 12 min to downtown, 5 min to Mission; direct to SFO

transit.apps: Real-time: 511.org / Transit app / UMO (ex-NextBus). Google Maps isn't always accurate for Muni.
transit.airport: From SFO: BART direct to Balboa Park (~30 min), then 8-min walk. Cheapest and often fastest way in.

checkout: Turn off lights, heaters, appliances, and electronics
Close and lock all windows and doors; lock the cottage door and gate keypads
Sign out of your streaming accounts on the TVs
Do a final walkthrough — check drawers and outlets for personal items

faqs.a: Deliveries go to the host's front door; Keith will bring packages to your door. Message ahead if expecting something.
The cottage is reached via a narrow alley — with very large suitcases, take it slow through the gate and alley.
Exterior only: backyard, pathway, front of house. None inside.
